cues.en: Y'all ready for this?
cues.zh: 準備好了嗎？

cues.en: We got step six, which is experimentation, and it's important to remember all of these steps here
cues.zh: 第六步是實驗，要記住，這些步驟，

cues.en: are a highly iterative process, meaning you might try one thing, find out it doesn't work, then try another and another and another and just keep going through this loop.
cues.zh: 都是高度迭代的過程；試一個方法，發現無效，再試另一個，不斷循環。

cues.en: Right.
cues.zh: 對。

cues.en: But how would all of this look in practice?
cues.zh: 實際做起來會是什麼樣子？

cues.en: Well, with a process like the one we've got here, machine learning projects become tool matching projects.
cues.zh: 有了這種流程，機器學習專案就成了工具配對專案。

cues.en: And that's what we're going to do.
cues.zh: 這就是要做的。

cues.en: We're going to use this process and learn the different tools for each step.
cues.zh: 使用這個流程，學習每一步的不同工具。

cues.en: So eventually you'll be able to start to look at a machine learning problem and think about, okay, I know what tools I can use for each of this step.
cues.zh: 最後看到機器學習問題，就能想到每一步能用什麼工具。

cues.en: We can break it down.
cues.zh: 把它拆開。

cues.en: I can use this for that, for that, and apply this process to whatever kind of problem you're working on.
cues.zh: 這裡用這個，那裡用那個，把流程套用到任何要處理的問題。

cues.en: For example, someone might come to you with a data set and ask you to find insights on it.
cues.zh: 例如有人帶著資料集，請你找出洞見。

cues.en: You might start by defining a problem with them, which is step one.
cues.zh: 可以先一起定義問題，這是第一步。

cues.en: Then you go through to step two and look at the data.
cues.zh: 接著第二步，查看資料。

cues.en: This part is called data analysis.
cues.zh: 這部分叫資料分析。

cues.en: Here you might define an evaluation metric based on the problem at the same time as inspecting the different features of the data, which is step three and step four.
cues.zh: 再根據問題定義評估指標，同時檢查不同特徵，也就是第三、四步。

cues.en: Once you know a little bit more about the data, you decide to build a machine learning model using the features you found to predict some target.
cues.zh: 更了解資料後，決定使用找到的特徵建立模型，預測某個目標。

cues.en: Now this is step five.
cues.zh: 這是第五步。

cues.en: Now your first model goes pretty well.
cues.zh: 第一個模型表現不錯。

cues.en: We've got the little green tick here.
cues.zh: 所以這裡有綠色勾號。

cues.en: You've managed to line up the inputs.
cues.zh: 成功對應輸入。

cues.en: So you've got a good model.
cues.zh: 有個好模型。

cues.en: You've matched the model to the problem and it's producing some some good outputs.
cues.zh: 模型適合問題，也產生不錯的輸出。

cues.en: So you decide to report what you found.
cues.zh: 所以報告發現。

cues.en: And after your initial report, your project manager asks to see if the model can be improved to get better results.
cues.zh: 初步報告後，專案經理問能不能改善模型，得到更好結果。

cues.en: So you do your research and find there's another approach you can take.
cues.zh: 你研究後，找到另一種做法。

cues.en: This is step six experimenting.
cues.zh: 這就是第六步，實驗。

cues.en: You might try a different model.
cues.zh: 可能換個模型。

cues.en: We've got model two and see how it goes and it performs pretty well.
cues.zh: 模型 2 的效果也不錯。

cues.en: Then if that didn't work when you reported it and it's like, Oh, maybe you can do a little bit better,
cues.zh: 報告後，如果還是不夠，對方希望再改善一點，

cues.en: you might try vary the input slightly and change your desired outputs and try a new model again.
cues.zh: 就稍微改變輸入、調整想要的輸出，再試新模型。

cues.en: Don't worry if all of this looks confusing, we're going to have plenty of practice doing this with hands on projects throughout the course.
cues.zh: 看起來不清楚也別擔心，整門課會透過實作專案大量練習。

cues.en: Remember at the start how we said there were three major steps we were going to do.
cues.zh: 還記得一開始說要做三大步驟。

cues.en: One, create a framework to match the framework to data science and machine learning tools.
cues.zh: 第一，建立框架；第二，把框架對應到資料科學與機器學習工具。

cues.en: And three, learn by doing.
cues.zh: 第三，做中學。

cues.en: Well, after going through the last couple of lectures, you've just ticked off step one We've now got a framework to use for the modelling section of machine learning projects.
cues.zh: 前面幾堂已完成第一步，有了用於機器學習專案建模階段的框架。

cues.en: Look how beautiful that is.
cues.zh: 多漂亮。

cues.en: Step one problem.
cues.zh: 第一步，問題，

cues.en: Definition.
cues.zh: 定義。

cues.en: Step two Data.
cues.zh: 第二步，資料。

cues.en: Step three Evaluation.
cues.zh: 第三步，評估。

cues.en: Step four Features.
cues.zh: 第四步，特徵。

cues.en: Step five Modelling.
cues.zh: 第五步，建模。

cues.en: Step six experimentation.
cues.zh: 第六步，實驗。

cues.en: All of this is an iterative process.
cues.zh: 全部都是迭代過程。

cues.en: Next up, we're going to learn what tools we can use to apply the framework to different projects.
cues.zh: 接著學習哪些工具能把框架套用到不同專案。

cues.en: And of course, to do all this, we're going to be working hands on writing machine learning code and creating projects of our own.
cues.zh: 當然會親自寫機器學習程式，建立自己的專案。

cues.en: And remember to check the resources section for anything extra you may need.
cues.zh: 記得查看資源區，取得額外所需內容。

cues.en: You can find all of what we've talked about there.
cues.zh: 剛才談的東西都能在那裡找到。
